A school built on character, not just marks.

"We want every learner to leave Derona standing on their own two feet — sterk in mind, in faith, and in character."

Derona Academy is a small, independent Christian school serving families in Kempton Park. We follow the CAPS curriculum from Grade R through Matric, and every learner is known by name — not just a number in a register.

As a registered non-profit, our focus stays where it belongs: on good teaching, small classes, and a school culture where faith and learning grow together.

Umalusi registered

Every qualification we award meets recognised national standards.

Small classes

Low learner-to-teacher ratios so no child gets lost in the crowd.

Christian foundation

Weekly devotions and values woven into everyday school life.

One school, three stages, one path to Matric.

Learners move through three phases at Derona, each one preparing them for the next — without ever changing schools.

R

Foundation Phase

Grade R to 3 — where literacy, numeracy, and a love of learning take root.

4

Intermediate & Senior

Grade 4 to 9 — building subject depth, discipline, and independent thinking.

10

FET Phase

Grade 10 to 12 — focused preparation for the NSC Matric exams and life beyond.

Life at Derona

A day at Derona is more than lessons — it's assembly devotions, sports on the field, and classrooms where learners are known by name.

How to enrol

Joining Derona Academy takes four simple steps, from your first phone call to your child's first day.

1

Call or enquire

Reach out by phone or the form below and tell us your child's grade.

2

Book a tour

Walk through our classrooms and meet the teachers who'll know your child by name.

3

Submit documents

We'll guide you through the application form and required school records.

4

Welcome to Derona

Confirm your child's place and get ready for their first day of school.

Come and see the school for yourself.

The best way to know if Derona is right for your child is to visit. Call us or send a message to arrange a tour.
